variants.name: Slipstream
variants.prompt: Use the attached purple eraser icon as a conceptual jumping-off point for a WILD NEW LOGO alternative for Kuizer, not as a composition to preserve. The user explicitly wants experimentation in flow, abstractness, and geometry, NOT another treatment of the same straight eraser. Direction SLIPSTREAM. Turn the eraser's diagonal white-and-lavender silhouette into a single broad sculptural ribbon that swoops from lower left, curls around a large open teardrop-shaped negative space, twists once, then accelerates into a slender rising tip at upper right. The chunky ivory leading end transitions into pale lavender and saturated orchid through the folded ribbon. The ribbon is a fluid abstract erasing gesture, almost a calligraphic brushstroke folded into an impossible object, NOT an identifiable household eraser, NOT a straight capsule, NOT an infinity symbol or generic circular swoosh. The inside fold has deep violet shading, the broad outside is luminous ivory with soft peach-lilac transitions. Deliberate asymmetry, dramatic change in width, beautiful tension between a thick rounded beginning and a thin expressive exit. Place this flowing abstract mark in front of a simple deep plum rounded-square tile, with the upper right ribbon tip breaking slightly past the tile edge. Keep the purple and ivory family as the connection to the source. Premium stylized 2.5D graphic icon: immaculate smooth surfaces, beautifully art-directed broad gradients, crisp curves, selective edge highlights, restrained dimensional layering. No photorealistic texture, realistic glass or metal, metallic collar, realistic rubber, crystals, dust, or sparkles. One bold recognizable abstract emblem. Square 1024x1024 canvas, centered with generous genuine transparent alpha margin outside the complete silhouette. No text, letters, labels or watermarks. One icon only, not a sheet. Be adventurous with the shape; this MUST be structurally different from the attached source.

variants.name: Phase Shift
variants.prompt: Create one WILD GEOMETRIC ALTERNATIVE to the attached Kuizer purple eraser icon. Reference is for the purple/ivory colour relationship and the idea of erasing, NOT for retaining the object or composition. The user explicitly wants experiments in abstractness and geometry, rather than cosmetic variants. Direction PHASE SHIFT. Rebuild the eraser as a striking abstract diagonal constellation of exactly three big geometric solids, separated by large deliberate zigzag gaps: a warm ivory truncated angular wedge at lower left, a broad lilac skewed parallelogram bridge offset to the left at center, and a saturated violet sharply tapered triangular prism at upper right pointing upward. Their intersecting diagonal planes and offset edges imply a single object breaking into ordered pieces. The overall silhouette should feel like a fragmented lightning bolt or deconstructed impossible monolith, powerful and architectural, with a pronounced open diagonal cut through its center. Three small simple square fragments drift away toward lower left along a carefully aligned diagonal, suggesting data being erased. Use long straight edges, sharp slanted working faces, a few softly rounded outer corners, generous negative space, deliberate 30-degree and 60-degree angles. NO recognizable pill, eraser capsule, chrome collar, white-and-purple rounded rectangle, or ribbon. No backing squircle: this free-standing fractured geometric mark IS the icon. Premium stylized 2.5D vector-like graphic object with bold flat planes, subtle broad gradients, clean selective edge light and shallow geometric shadows. Palette ivory, lavender, electric iris purple, deep plum, one very restrained hot-pink edge accent. No realistic textures, metal, glass, photography, realistic debris, microdetail, dust, or sparkles. It should look like a radical art-directed software brand mark, not a real-world tool or a product photo. Square 1024x1024 with genuine alpha transparency around and through the separated shapes, complete icon centered with generous margin, fills 78 percent of frame. No text, letters, watermark, labels, or surrounding scene. One icon only, not a sheet.
